_comment: The ship's manifest. Each unit fills one cargo bay and is bought on credit, adding 'debt' marks to the colony's starting debt. 'recommended' is the default load; with it a game starts exactly as before the manifest existed.

items.name: Water bladders
items.desc: 60 water. Worth more on dry worlds.

items.name: Starting funds
items.desc: 300 marks in the colony account, for early payments.

items.name: Prefab Mirror Field
items.desc: A Mirror Field you can place for free.

items.name: Prefab Vent Tap
items.desc: A Vent Tap you can place for free on a vent.

items.name: Prefab Splitter
items.desc: A Splitter you can place for free.

items.name: Prefab Kelp Vat
items.desc: A Kelp Vat you can place for free.

items.name: Prefab Forge
items.desc: A Forge you can place for free.

items.name: Prefab Survey Lab
items.desc: A Survey Lab you can place for free.

items.name: Supply pod
items.desc: Stays aboard the ship in orbit. Call it down any time for 50 alloy, 40 food and 40 oxygen.

items.name: Survey probes
items.desc: Dropped ahead of the ship. The landing-site screen also shows what lies in the Deep under each site.
